title: GeoView 3D Tiles Schema
comments: Configuration for the GeoView 3D Tiles (deck.gl) package.

isOpen.description: Specifies whether the 3D panel is initially open or closed

tilesetUrl.description: URL of the 3D Tiles 1.1 tileset.json to render. Use REPLACE_ME as a placeholder until a real tileset is provided.

version.description: The schema version used to validate the configuration file. The schema should enumerate the list of versions accepted by this version of the viewer.
